required_pr_review.summary: Pullfrog is the sole required exact-head AI review source.
required_pr_review.fallback_summary: Self-managed, Mergeguez, and CodeRabbit review evidence cannot replace exact-head Pullfrog review.

local_validation.summary: All available local gates passed: 121 GitHub helper tests, 29 focused remediation tests, checksum-verified actionlint and workflow-policy validation, Python compilation, zero-change materialization, canonical/live workflow identity, JSON metadata parsing, whitespace checks, and public-safety/private-context scans. The local Speculoos binary is unavailable, so independent hosted Speculoos evidence remains required after publication.

github_checks.summary: No pull request is recorded for this local write-capable branch. Publication, activation, and the hosted pilot require separate authorization; hosted checks must be read live at the exact published head before merge or activation.

pullfrog_review.summary: A fresh exact-head Pullfrog review plus app-bound pullfrog and pullfrog-approval checks are required after publication and after every head update.

speculoos_evidence.summary: Independent hosted Speculoos evidence is required on the same exact head and cannot be replaced by Pullfrog output.

self_managed.summary: Not accepted as normal or fallback review evidence.

mergeguez_review.summary: Mergeguez is not a reviewer in the target architecture; its remaining duties are separately approved publication and human-authorized merge execution.
